verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say it can 'automate questionnaires' as part of accelerating security reviews, so questionnaire automation is in scope. Nothing describes ingesting questionnaires in their native formats or returning answers in the format the customer sent. Missing for 10: import of SIG, CAIQ and spreadsheet questionnaires, support for customer questionnaire portals, export in the original format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
